name: heic-converter
title: HEIC Converter
description: Convert HEIC images to JPEG format directly from Finder
author: yavor

commands.name: convert-heic-to-jpeg
commands.title: Convert HEIC to JPEG
commands.subtitle: Converts selected HEIC files to JPEG files
commands.description: Select HEIC files in Finder, then run this command to convert them to JPEG format in the same directory

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
